title: Two Ways of Seeing a River
subtitle: The river-as-book metaphor opens two readings of one scene, then the doctor analogy asks what expertise gains and loses.
genre: Reflective essay · extended metaphor, contrast, and analogy
question: What does expertise reveal, and what kind of wonder can it displace?
thesis: Learning to read the river gives Twain valuable professional knowledge, yet transforms beautiful appearances into practical signals and diminishes his earlier wonder.
thesisZh: 学会解读河流让吐温获得宝贵的专业知识，却也把美丽景象变成实用信号，削弱了他早年的惊叹。
conclusion: The doctor analogy extends the tension beyond piloting and leaves open whether mastering a profession brings greater gain or loss.
conclusionZh: 医生的类比把这种张力延伸到领航之外，并留下一个未决问题：精通职业带来的究竟是更多收获，还是更多失落。

design.pattern: River-as-book gateway → mirrored novice and pilot readings → doctor analogy and an open question
design.rationale: 第一段作入口，第二、三段并置为同一景物的审美与专业解读，末段以医生类比汇合；河水蓝、落日金、沉思紫对应三种阅读层次。

stages.title: The same surface speaks differently to two readers
stages.summary: The river becomes a readable book for the pilot, while passengers see attractive pictures without understanding the danger beneath them.
stages.summaryZh: 河流成为领航员能读懂的书，乘客则只看见美丽图画，无法理解其下的危险。

nodes.label: The passenger’s reading
nodes.text: To an untrained passenger, the river is a [[dead language]] whose surface offers pretty pictures.
nodes.zh: 对于未经领航训练的乘客，河流是一种无法读懂的语言，表面只是漂亮的图画。

nodes.label: The pilot’s reading
nodes.text: The trained pilot finds a changing, absorbing book; a faint dimple warns of a hidden [[wreck or rock]].
nodes.zh: 训练有素的领航员读到一本不断变化、引人入胜的书；细微水纹警告着水下的沉船或岩石。

compact.label: Read the River
compact.keywords: Passengers see pictures; pilots read hidden dangers
compact.zh: 解读河流：乘客看图画，领航员读出隐患

balanced.label: Two Readers, One River
balanced.summary: The river is a book: passengers admire its pictures, while the trained pilot reads changing signs of hidden danger.
balanced.detail: A faint dimple signals a submerged wreck or rock.
balanced.zh: 两种读者，同一条河：河流如同一本书，乘客欣赏其中的图画，受过训练的领航员则读出不断变化的危险信号。浅浅的水纹暗示水下的沉船或岩石。

stages.title: A valuable acquisition is set against a remembered sunset
stages.summary: Twain acknowledges knowledge gained and beauty lost, then recalls the richly colored sunset he saw as a novice.
stages.summaryZh: 吐温承认自己获得了知识却失去了美感，随后回忆初学领航时看见的绚丽落日。

nodes.label: Sun, Log, Mark
nodes.text: Blood-red water brightens into gold around a black log; a slanting mark [[sparkles]] on the surface.
nodes.zh: 血红的河水渐渐变成金色，映衬着黑色浮木；一道斜纹在水面闪闪发亮。

nodes.label: Rings, Circles, Silver
nodes.text: Tumbling rings resemble an [[opal]]; graceful circles and delicate lines cover smooth water; a trail shines like silver in the forest’s shadow.
nodes.zh: 翻滚的水圈宛如蛋白石；优美的圆圈和细腻的线条铺展在平滑水面；一道水迹在森林阴影里闪着银光。

nodes.label: Tree and Wonder
nodes.text: A dead tree’s leafy bough glows like a [[flame]]; changing light enriches the whole scene with new colors.
nodes.zh: 枯树上的带叶枝条像火焰般发光；变化的光线不断为整幅景象增添新的色彩。

balanced.label: A Novice's Aesthetic Wonder
balanced.summary: Twain remembers a sunset in which blood-red water, sparkling marks, opal-like rings, and a glowing branch inspire speechless delight.
balanced.zh: 初学者的审美惊叹：吐温回忆一场落日，血红的河水、闪烁的斜纹、蛋白石般的水圈与发光的树枝使他陶醉得说不出话。

stages.title: The remembered scene is translated into navigation signals
stages.summary: As rapture fades, the same sunset becomes a set of signs about weather, water levels, hidden hazards, and navigation.
stages.summaryZh: 随着狂喜消退，同一片落日景象变成了有关天气、水位、隐蔽危险和航行的信号。

nodes.label: Sun, Log, Mark
nodes.text: The sun predicts wind; the log signals a [[rising river]]; the slanting mark reveals a dangerous [[reef]].
nodes.zh: 落日预示将起风；浮木表明河水上涨；斜纹揭示危险的暗礁。

nodes.label: Rings, Circles, Silver
nodes.text: Boiling rings reveal a dissolving bar and changing channel; circles warn of [[shoaling]]; the silver streak exposes a new [[snag]].
nodes.zh: 翻滚的水圈显露正在消散的沙洲和变化的航道；圆圈警示水变浅；银色水迹暴露出新的水下枯树障碍。

nodes.label: Tree and Navigation
nodes.text: The glowing tree becomes a dying night-time [[landmark]]. Twain recalls speechless rapture, then gradually ceasing to notice the river’s beauty.
nodes.zh: 发光的树变成了行将消失的夜航地标。吐温先回忆无言的狂喜，再写自己逐渐不再留意河流的美。

stages.title: A doctor’s eye extends an unresolved question
stages.summary: Practical usefulness displaces beauty, and the imagined doctor’s view broadens the question of what professional knowledge costs.
stages.summaryZh: 实用价值取代了美感，想象中的医生视角进一步拓展了专业知识代价这一问题。

nodes.label: The pilot’s new measure of value
nodes.text: River features now matter to Twain for their [[usefulness]] in piloting a steamboat safely.
nodes.zh: 河流的各种特征，如今对吐温的价值在于它们能否帮助汽船安全航行。

nodes.label: A parallel professional gaze
nodes.text: Twain imagines a doctor reading a lovely flush as a sign of [[disease]], and wonders whether diagnosis obscures beauty.
nodes.zh: 吐温想象医生把美丽的红晕解读为疾病征兆，并追问诊断的目光是否遮蔽了美。

nodes.label: The unanswered balance
nodes.text: Has learning a trade brought more [[gain or loss]]? The closing questions leave the balance unresolved.
nodes.zh: 学习一门职业带来更多收获，还是更多失落？结尾的追问没有给出确定的权衡结果。

balanced.label: What Does Expertise Cost?
balanced.summary: An imagined doctor sees disease in a lovely complexion; Twain asks whether professional knowledge brings greater gain or loss.
balanced.detail: The analogy extends the question; it does not settle it.
balanced.zh: 专业知识的代价是什么：想象中的医生从美丽的面容读出病征；吐温追问，专业知识究竟带来更多收获还是损失。类比拓展了问题，却没有给出定论。
